beeby2016diverse; membrane area one flagellar motor takes: the disc out to its stators' outer edge, pi (20 + 3.5)^2 nm2 = 1,735 nm2, taken as 1,700. The 11 MotA5MotB2 stators of the enteric (Salmonella) motor exert force at a radius of 20 nm, around a C ring of 22 nm radius (Beeby et al. 2016, cryo-ET); each stator's MotA pentamer is ~6-7 nm across in the membrane (Santiveri et al. 2020, Deme et al. 2020 cryo-EM; the width from a secondary summary, to check), half of it 3.5 nm. Inside the stator ring sit the MS ring and export gate, so no other protein uses that membrane (confidence: medium: the radius is measured, the exclusion disc is an estimate; the proteins alone cover ~1,000 nm2)
